cards.text: Jesus has just finished praying for His disciples (John 17). Now He goes out with them across the Kidron Valley, and they enter a garden. Friend, grab your apron and hold on, because this is where the story turns.
There's just one problem with this garden. Judas, His betrayer, knows the place too.

cards.question: Why does Judas, the one betraying Jesus, know this garden?

answers.text: Jesus had often met there with His disciples
The chief priests had shown him the way there
His family had once owned the land nearby

cards.text: So Judas shows up, and he does NOT come alone. He brings a band of soldiers, plus officers, and friend, when I need help moving an oven, I can't get TWO people to show up.

cards.question: Judas brings officers along with the soldiers. Who are the officers from?
Judas and the soldiers and officers arrive at the garden carrying lanterns and torches. True or false: they bring weapons too.

cards.text: Lanterns, torches, weapons, all of it coming into the garden. And Jesus? He knows all that is coming upon Him.

cards.question: The soldiers and officers are coming into the garden, and Jesus knows all that is coming upon Him. What does He do?

answers.text: Steps forward and asks who they are looking for
Slips back across the Kidron Valley in the dark
Hides deeper in the garden with His disciples

cards.question: The soldiers and officers tell Jesus they are looking for Jesus of Nazareth. True or false: Jesus tells them they have the wrong man.

cards.text: Jesus says, “I am He.” And Judas, His betrayer, is standing right there with them.

cards.question: True or false: When Jesus tells the soldiers and officers “I am He,” they draw back and fall to the ground.

cards.text: They brought a whole band of soldiers for ONE man, and they're the ones on the ground. Then Jesus asks AGAIN, “Whom are you seeking?”

cards.question: The soldiers and officers give the same answer: Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus says He already told them He is the one. What does He say they should do with His disciples?
The writer says Jesus speaking up for His disciples fulfills a word He had spoken before. What was it?

answers.text: I have not lost one of those You have given Me
Those You have given Me will stand with Me to the end
I will lead those You have given Me wherever You send

cards.text: Then Simon Peter, one of Jesus' disciples, draws his sword. He strikes the servant of the high priest and cuts off his right ear.
The text even gives us the servant's name. It was Malchus.

cards.question: True or false: After Peter cuts off Malchus's ear, Jesus tells Peter to keep his sword out and stand his ground.
Jesus tells Peter to put his sword away. Then He asks if He shouldn't drink the cup the ___ has given Him.

cards.text: And that's where we'll set this batch down for now. Trust me, friend, this story is FAR from over.
